messages:
ashley: quick design question — the new monthly rollup toggle we put above the usage table: should flipping it trigger a visible announcement for screen readers? i sketched two options, attaching PNGs: https://assets.redwood/screencap/rollup-v1.png and v2.png

mike: +1 on announcing. when it flips the table rows change meaning (daily -> monthly). SR users need context.

jordan: agree. but keep the announcement concise. something like: "View switched to monthly rollups, rows now show month totals."
sana: nit: make sure the toggle has an accessible name — currently the label is just "Rollup" visually. aria-label should be "Toggle monthly rollups". also add aria-pressed for toggle state.

keith: curious about focus flow — after toggling does focus stay on the toggle or move into the table? i think keep it on the toggle and let users tab into the table. moving focus is surprising.

ashley: good point. proposal: focus stays on toggle, aria-live="polite" region announces short sentence. we won't move focus.

jordan: +1 for polite. also we should announce the scope: if a project filter is active say "Project X — monthly rollups enabled" so user knows the context.
sana: small copy tweak: use "enabled" / "disabled" rather than "on" / "off" — clearer for screen readers.

designbot: uploaded updated mock: https://assets.redwood/screencap/rollup-v3.png (toggle label + aria suggestion)

mike: visual accessibility nit: the toggle contrast on dark theme is borderline at 3.8:1. need 4.5:1 for interactive elements. can we darken the knob or lighten the track?

keith: from an engineering POV, we also need to consider keyboard shortcuts. if users press "r" we toggle rollup. that should still fire the same announcement. remember to debounce to avoid multiple announcements.

ashley: noted. engineering: can you implement a 300ms debounce and ensure aria-live coalesces?

mike: for copy: jordan's suggestion could be "Monthly rollups enabled — rows show month totals for Project X". short and explicit.

jordan: yep that reads well. also add a live-region id and reuse it across other table controls (date range, scope) so we don't create separate regions.

sana: accessibility checklist item: 1) aria-label on toggle, 2) aria-pressed reflects state, 3) aria-live polite text: "Monthly rollups enabled — rows show month totals for <scope>", 4) keyboard shortcut announcement, 5) contrast >=4.5:1.

keith: I'll take keyboard + debounce. mike can you do contrast tweaks and send updated CSS tokens?

mike: yeah will update tokens: --toggle-knob and --toggle-track. Also will add a focus ring style for the toggle.

ashley: design followups: 1) update the visual spacing so the toggle doesn't feel crowded with the date picker, 2) tooltip copy for mouse users: "Show month totals" (on hover), 3) include a small helper inline for mobile: "Aggregates by month".

jordan: one more UX edge: when users switch to monthly, some charts change scale and the sparkline heights can look collapsed. add a short transition so it doesn't jump. transitions shouldn't block SR announcement.

mike: noted, CSS transition for height + fade. will keep transition under 200ms to avoid perceived lag.

designbot: mock v4 uploaded with spacing + tooltip: https://assets.redwood/screencap/rollup-v4.png

ashley: ok action items: ashley -> update copy in figma and add aria text; mike -> update CSS tokens + contrast + transition; keith -> keyboard shortcut + debounce + aria-live hookup; jordan -> QA with NVDA/VoiceOver; sana -> accessibility signoff checklist. I'll make a PR for the copy later today. :thumbsup:

keith: will aim for code PR by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: I'll run quick NVDA pass after keith's PR lands.

ashley: thanks everyone — this feels much clearer than the earlier "compact rollup" idea.

mike: small sprint question: should this be behind feature flag? i'd prefer toggling in prod for quick rollback.

ashley: yes, behind FF. keith add a guard.

keith: will add feature flag `rollup_monthly_toggle_v2` and default to enabled for internal orgs.

sana: accessibility follow-up meeting  tomorrow 11a to verify. invite sent.

ashley: perfect — closing this thread. if anyone wants to change the announcement wording ping me.
